review.scope: Directed frontend/UX security review for N8.11. No frontend-specific product delta was required because no proven P0/P1/P2 frontend gap remained after source review; stage is therefore truthfully N/A for implementation while validation remains mandatory.
verifiedControls: Repository search found no localStorage or sessionStorage usage that would persist authentication/session material in browser storage.
Repository search found no bypassSecurityTrust usage and no innerHTML usage requiring a security hardening change in this scope.
Backend authorization remains authoritative; frontend permission/UI behavior is not treated as a security boundary.
The exact functional candidate completed npm install, lint and production frontend build successfully.
